title: Klio
description: Backup and WAL observability for Klio, built from the Prometheus export of Klio's OpenTelemetry metrics.

panels.title: Backups in progress
panels.description: Base backups currently running, per cluster.

panels.title: Time since last successful backup
panels.description: Elapsed time since the most recent base backup completed successfully, per cluster. A value well above the backup interval means that cluster's backups have stopped succeeding.

panels.title: Time since last failed backup
panels.description: Elapsed time since the most recent base backup failure, per cluster. A small value means a failure happened recently.

panels.title: Latest backup duration
panels.description: Wall-clock duration of the most recent base backup, per cluster.

panels.title: Time since last backup started
panels.description: Elapsed time since the most recent base backup started, per cluster. Compare against the latest duration to tell whether a backup is still running or overdue.

panels.title: Backup success ratio
panels.description: Fraction of base backup runs that succeeded over the selected time range (successful runs / total runs), per cluster.

panels.title: Successful backups (24h)
panels.description: Base backups that completed successfully in the last 24 hours, per cluster. Counter resets on plugin restart make long-window counts approximate.

panels.title: Successful backups (7d)
panels.description: Base backups that completed successfully in the last 7 days, per cluster. Counter resets on plugin restart make long-window counts approximate.

panels.title: Backup run rate by cluster and outcome
panels.description: Rate of base backup runs, broken down by cluster and outcome (success or failure).

panels.title: Backup failure rate by cluster and category
panels.description: Rate of failed base backup runs, broken down by cluster and failure category, to show why backups are failing.

panels.title: Backup duration p95 by cluster
panels.description: 95th-percentile wall-clock duration of base backup runs (across all outcomes), per cluster, computed over the whole selected range so the lines stay populated between runs. Widen the dashboard range to span several backups for a stable reading; if the range contains no backup for a cluster, that cluster's line is empty.

panels.title: Backups by cluster and outcome
panels.description: Count of base backup runs per time bucket, split by cluster and outcome. Bars aggregate the number of backups over each interval (per day on a multi-day range).

panels.title: Streaming timeline by cluster
panels.description: PostgreSQL timeline the WAL streaming client is streaming, per cluster, over time. A step up marks a failover on that cluster.

panels.title: WAL block send duration (p50/p95/p99) by cluster
panels.description: Percentile latency of the client's gRPC send of a WAL block to the server, per cluster. Most meaningful under active write load; on an idle or low-write cluster, WAL blocks are sent too infrequently for the underlying histogram_quantile to be reliable, so the line may look sparse or noisy rather than absent.

panels.title: Server uptime
panels.description: Time since the Klio server process started, per server. A sudden drop means that server's StatefulSet restarted.

panels.title: Latest WAL timeline by cluster and tier
panels.description: PostgreSQL timeline of the latest WAL written per cluster and tier, over time. A step up marks a promotion or failover.

panels.title: Base snapshots by cluster and tier
panels.description: Base backup snapshots currently retained per cluster and tier (the cluster is derived from the Kopia snapshot source).

panels.title: Latest snapshot size
panels.description: Size on the backend of the most recent base backup snapshot, per cluster and tier.

panels.title: Latest snapshot files
panels.description: Number of files in the most recent base backup snapshot, per cluster and tier.

panels.title: Latest snapshot dirs
panels.description: Number of directories in the most recent base backup snapshot, per cluster and tier.

panels.title: Latest snapshot age
panels.description: Age of the most recent base backup snapshot, per cluster and tier. Should stay below the backup interval; a tier-2 value drifting above tier-1 means remote relay is lagging.

panels.title: Oldest snapshot age
panels.description: Age of the oldest retained base backup snapshot, per cluster and tier, reflecting each tier's effective retention horizon.

panels.title: Latest backup age (start)
panels.description: Elapsed time since the most recently retained PostgreSQL backup started, per cluster and tier.

panels.title: Latest backup age (completion)
panels.description: Elapsed time since the most recently retained PostgreSQL backup completed, per cluster and tier.

panels.title: Oldest backup age (start)
panels.description: Elapsed time since the oldest retained PostgreSQL backup started, per cluster and tier, reflecting each tier's effective retention horizon.

panels.title: Oldest backup age (completion)
panels.description: Elapsed time since the oldest retained PostgreSQL backup completed, per cluster and tier, reflecting each tier's effective retention horizon.

panels.title: PostgreSQL backups retained by cluster and tier
panels.description: Number of PostgreSQL backups currently retained per cluster and tier.

panels.title: Latest backup LSN by cluster and tier
panels.description: Start and end LSN of the latest retained PostgreSQL backup, per cluster and tier.

panels.title: Oldest backup LSN by cluster and tier
panels.description: Start and end LSN of the oldest retained PostgreSQL backup, per cluster and tier.

panels.title: Backup timeline by cluster and tier
panels.description: PostgreSQL timeline of the latest and oldest retained backup, per cluster and tier, over time. The latest and oldest lines diverging means the retention window spans a promotion or failover.

panels.title: WAL files written rate by cluster and tier
panels.description: Rate of WAL files written by the server, split by cluster and storage tier.

panels.title: WAL bytes written rate by cluster and tier
panels.description: Rate of WAL bytes written by the server, split by cluster and storage tier.

panels.title: Time since last WAL written by cluster and tier
panels.description: Elapsed time since the server last wrote a WAL file for each cluster and tier. A stale tier-1 value means PostgreSQL stopped shipping WALs; a stale tier-2 value means the remote backend stopped receiving them.

panels.title: Latest written LSN by cluster and tier
panels.description: Most recent WAL LSN the server has written for each cluster and tier, as a byte offset.

panels.title: Backup verification rate by outcome and tier
panels.description: Rate of base backup verification checks, broken down by outcome and tier (the verification counter carries no cluster_name, so it is a per-server signal).

panels.title: WAL block duration (p50/p95/p99) by path and stage
panels.description: Percentile per-block WAL processing duration on the server, split by `path` (put ingest / get serve) and `stage`, aggregated across the selected clusters.

panels.title: WAL file get duration (p50/p95/p99) by tier
panels.description: Percentile duration of a complete WAL file gRPC get, split by the tier that served it, aggregated across the selected clusters.

panels.title: WAL tier-2 upload duration (p50/p95/p99) by cluster
panels.description: Percentile duration of the tier-2 archival upload to remote storage, per cluster.

panels.title: Tier-2 relay rate by cluster and outcome
panels.description: Rate of tier-2 relay attempts after a backup (migration and verification), per cluster and outcome.

panels.title: Maintenance run rate by cluster, tier and outcome
panels.description: Rate of post-backup maintenance runs (base-snapshot retention and WAL cleanup), per cluster, tier and outcome.

panels.title: Queue messages by stream
panels.description: Messages currently held in each NATS JetStream stream of the embedded queue, per server.

panels.title: Queue bytes by stream
panels.description: Bytes currently held in each NATS JetStream stream of the embedded queue, per server.

panels.title: Tier-1 Replication lag (Bytes)
panels.description: Byte distance between the primary's current WAL LSN and the LSN Klio's streaming client has flushed, from CloudNativePG's pg_stat_replication.

panels.title: Tier-1 Replication lag (Seconds)
panels.description: Time between a commit on the primary and Klio's streaming client flushing the corresponding WAL, from CloudNativePG's pg_stat_replication.

panels.title: Tier-2 archival lag (Tier-1 LSN gap)
panels.description: LSN distance between tier 1 (local disk) and tier 2 (remote storage) per cluster. A growing gap means remote archival is falling behind. Scoped by $server and $cluster (not $namespace), since the server tags these series with its own namespace.
